live.heading: Watch the machine work
live.lede: These panels only appear once your browser connects to the live event stream the collector and the commission checker write to. If they are not showing, everything above this line is still complete on its own — nothing on this page waits on them.

machineRoom.title: The hourly pass
machineRoom.lede: Every source the collector has checked recently, most recent first.

commission.title: A commission being checked
commission.lede: One request to add a new source, followed step by step as it is probed and judged.
commission.roleReference: the reference it is checked against
commission.resultNoData: had no data for this currency
commission.resultWrongShape: did not report a usable number

callTail.title: What people are asking
callTail.lede: Tool and country only, the same rule the stream itself is built to keep. Nothing else about who asked ever reaches this page.
